sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent lattice bbox, the full-line coordinates, and the side-partitioned marker sets.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the sparse color-3 lattice, compute its original bounding box and full rows/columns, then classify each color-6 marker as top, bottom, left, or right relative to that bbox.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Within each side-partition, select the nearest marker under the hidden setting, derive the new boundary, move original boundary lines, extend internal full lines, and restore all markers.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot choose candidates or extrema until Step A has fixed the bbox and side membership. Decrementing bbox c1 reclassifies an edge-aligned top marker as right, which changes the chosen boundaries and therefore the final grid.
